plain_english.headline: A narrow market, calm on the surface but with single stocks moving very differently underneath. Best fit: a stock-picker's market — the index tells you very little about the average name.
because: A handful of big names are carrying the index — the average stock is falling behind. This has been going on long enough to look tired. Breadth is near the bottom of its 12-month range, which is usually where it turns.

Single stocks are much more volatile than the index, and the gap is still growing. It widened by 1.0 points over the last month and is now wider than 84% of readings in the past two years. Gaps this wide and still growing have come before index falls of 5 to 7 percent. The index itself is quiet, with VIX at 14.9, lower than 90% of the past two years.
Option dealers are positioned in a way that damps moves — rallies get sold into and dips get bought.
Trend-following funds are mixed across the 18 markets we track, and 2 of those positions are stretched. Crowded trades unwind quickly, so the size guidance is cut.
Big speculators are unusually long gold, copper, corn and 4 others; unusually short natural gas and the long bond (CFTC data to 2026-09-15).

Together, that is a fragile setup, not a confident one: a lot of money is already leaning the same way, so a break past the levels below would force that SAME money to reverse fast, accelerating whatever move already started rather than fading it.

1 warning sign lit: breadth is rolling over toward its own average. A further 9 showed up on individual markets. No single one of these is a reason to sell. They matter when several point the same way as the breadth reading.
plain_english.so_what: Buy cheap index downside. Small size — this one is tactical and time-sensitive. Size at 0.50x your normal risk (cut because the trend is crowded).
watch_for: If the dollar trades below 99.84 (0.6% away), trend funds start selling.
If gold trades below 4,332.25 (0.6% away), trend funds start selling.
Watch for the average stock keeping pace with the index again. That ends the leadership trade and starts the breadth trade.
This reading would strengthen if dispersion NORMAL (spread 21.57) reversed.

levels.if_it_breaks: Below here stocks move together and selection stops paying. Only direction matters in that regime.
Above this, protection is already expensive. A spike through it is not a fresh reason to sell.
Low correlation means stocks trade on their own news and selection pays. Rising back through the middle of its range means everything starts moving together again, and only direction matters.
